title: Agent Guardrail: Policy, Budget & Replay for LLM Tool Calls
description: A policy-enforcement, cost-budgeting, tracing and deterministic-replay middleware for LLM agent tool calls, with an in-process guard() decorator and a FastAPI sidecar for non-Python agent stacks.

title: agent-trace-lens: Tracing & Timeline Visualization for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
description: A lightweight Python SDK, SQLite store, CLI, and FastAPI timeline viewer for recording and inspecting nested agent/tool/LLM spans across multi-agent runs.

title: agent-eval-harness: Evaluation & Regression-Testing Harness for LLM Agents
description: A pluggable-scorer, YAML-defined task suite runner with JSONL result storage and run-over-run regression detection, plus a CLI for gating CI on agent behavior.
